clue.text: Genuine cessation of hostilities about to emerge

indicators.note: letting a letter come out of the word leaves it removed from the longer piece

parts.note: a truce is a halt to fighting agreed by both sides
C is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A ceasefire is about to be announced, and it is a real one.
explanation.definitionFit: Something genuine is real or authentic, the sense of a true friend or true copy.

clue.text: Result finally seen in excellent side without any weak points

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written here with the figure as the letter I

indicators.note: the final letter is spotted sitting inside the longer piece

parts.note: right is one side, as opposed to left

indicators.note: points to the closing letter of the word Result

explanation.surface: A team that played superbly and won had no weaknesses in defence.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 (excellent) is written AI; 'finally' takes T from 'Result', which goes inside AIRIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: An airtight argument or plan has no flaw or loophole anywhere, an idiom from a sealed container.

clue.text: Go one better than old lover with offspring, as you may say

indicators.note: signals that the phrase is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: an ex is a former partner and seed means offspring, together EX SEED

explanation.surface: Someone tries to outdo a former partner who now has children.
explanation.definitionFit: To exceed is to surpass or go beyond, so it means going one better.

clue.text: One with financial security — such is Lisbon dealer

definitions.text: One with financial security — such is Lisbon dealer

parts.words: One with financial security — such is Lisbon dealer
parts.note: an investor owning bonds has a secure investment; the phrase Lisbon dealer literally holds the run of letters B-O-N-D across its two words

explanation.surface: A Portuguese trader in Lisbon is described as an investor with secure savings.
explanation.walkthrough: The joke is that 'lisBON Dealer' contains BOND, so the phrase is itself a holder of a bond.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who owns bonds holds a debt security issued by a government or company.

clue.text: That man? Is held in memory for showing courage

parts.note: he refers to a male person

indicators.note: the word Is is kept inside the memory term

parts.note: ROM is read-only memory in computing

explanation.surface: A man is remembered for his bravery.
explanation.definitionFit: Heroism is the display of great bravery, as shown by a hero.

clue.text: House on street with a perennial plant

explanation.surface: A home on a road has a long-lived plant in its garden.
explanation.definitionFit: The hosta is a shade-loving garden plant with broad leaves that returns each year.

clue.text: Men are trained specially for the sea

indicators.note: the letters are arranged in a special new order rather than as given

explanation.surface: Sailors are given special training for going to sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mediterranean is the sea between southern Europe and North Africa, the sea to many Europeans.

clue.text: African has ox butchered

indicators.note: cut up like meat, so the letters are chopped and reassembled

explanation.surface: An African herdsman has slaughtered an ox.
explanation.definitionFit: The Xhosa are a people of South Africa, so one of them is an African.

clue.text: What's surprisingly anodyne makes one cross

indicators.note: the letters turn out in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: Something bland and inoffensive somehow manages to upset a person.
explanation.walkthrough: The irony is that 'anodyne' means harmless, yet its letters make the opposite feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Cross is an informal word for irritated or angry, a direct synonym.

clue.text: When getting little money, rise is wanted!

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as he left'
a cent is a coin of small value

explanation.surface: Someone on a tiny wage wants a pay rise.
explanation.definitionFit: An ascent is an upward climb or slope, a rise in ground or position.

clue.text: Worrying about study when there's ambient sound

indicators.note: ambient means surrounding, so the sound wraps around the study

parts.note: ding is the sound of a bell
to read a subject is to study it at university

explanation.surface: A student frets over revising while there is background noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreading something is fearing it in advance, anxiously anticipating it.

clue.text: Shrewd, but unable to see what is under one's nose?

definitions.meaning: having foresight and good judgement about the future

definitions.text: unable to see what is under one's nose?
definitions.meaning: literally long-sighted, seeing distant things but not nearby ones

explanation.surface: Someone clever about the future but blind to the obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both prudent about the future and, literally, unable to focus on close objects.

clue.text: Filth — stomach's churning over and it upset head too

indicators.note: turning over, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: tum is informal for stomach, with the possessive S

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned up, read from the bottom

parts.note: taken as written
a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness or Sheerness

explanation.surface: Something disgusting makes the stomach churn and the head spin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'churning over' turns TUMS to SMUT, 'upset' turns IT to TI; NESS is a headland.
explanation.definitionFit: Smuttiness is obscenity or dirtiness, the quality of indecent talk or material.

clue.text: One animal and another crossing railway

indicators.note: the ox straddles the railway, so it goes around the letters

parts.note: another animal, here the ox

explanation.surface: Two animals wander over a railway line.
explanation.definitionFit: The oryx is a large straight-horned antelope of Africa and Arabia.

clue.text: Document a nerd composed is withdrawn

indicators.note: the letters are put together into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A paper written by a geek has been pulled.
explanation.definitionFit: An order that is countermanded is revoked or cancelled, so it is withdrawn.

clue.text: Expression of surprise — sailor turned up after party in foreign city!

indicators.note: the sailor piece comes after the party piece

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise
a do is an informal party

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is flipped to read upwards

parts.note: AB is able-bodied seaman

explanation.surface: A sailor at a party abroad cries out in surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Córdoba is a city in Spain, and also in Argentina, so a city abroad.

clue.text: European in clerical garb given a new Scottish name

parts.note: an alb is a white robe worn by priests
Ian is the Scottish form of John

explanation.surface: A churchman from Europe in his robes takes a new Scottish name.
explanation.definitionFit: An Albanian comes from Albania, a Balkan country in southeastern Europe.

clue.text: Granular stuff in bottle

definitions.meaning: small particles of stone or sand
British slang for courage or nerve

explanation.surface: Sand or particles found inside a bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both coarse particles and courage, matching bottle in its British slang sense of nerve.

clue.text: Moving awkwardly with stick, collecting fossil resin

indicators.note: gathering in, so the first piece takes the second inside it

parts.note: to cling is to stick fast
amber is hardened ancient tree resin

explanation.surface: Someone hobbles along with a walking stick, picking up amber.
explanation.definitionFit: Clambering is climbing or scrambling clumsily, using hands and feet.

clue.text: Mark's store, first thing you see in town

parts.note: a cache is a hidden store

indicators.note: takes the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Mark's shop is the first thing visitors see in town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' looks like a man's name owning the store; it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A cachet is a distinguishing mark or seal, such as a stamp of prestige.

clue.text: Playing group giving excuse for tennis postponement?

definitions.meaning: read as two words, ..., a reason a tennis match cannot start

explanation.surface: A band gives a reason why a tennis match is delayed.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonet is a group of nine performers, just as a quartet is four.

clue.text: Fabulous bird returns, coming to recess in cliff road

indicators.note: comes back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: the roc is a giant bird of Arabian legend
a niche is a recess in a wall

explanation.surface: A mythical bird flies back to nest in a hollow in a cliff by the road.
explanation.definitionFit: A corniche is a road cut along the face of a cliff, especially by the sea.

clue.text: Smelling no wickedness? Good!

parts.note: sin is wrongdoing

explanation.surface: Someone sniffs around and finds nothing wicked, which is good.
explanation.definitionFit: Nosing is sniffing or smelling about, as an animal does with its nose.

clue.text: Noticed radiance husband emitted

indicators.note: sent out, so the letter leaves the word

parts.note: sheen is a glossy shine

explanation.surface: Someone noticed the glow given off by her husband.
explanation.definitionFit: Seen is the past participle of see, so it means noticed or observed.

clue.text: Man perhaps hiding behind a church feature?

indicators.note: the isle piece follows the A

parts.note: the Isle of Man is one example of an isle

explanation.surface: A man is lurking behind something in a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' looks like a person hiding; it is the Isle of Man, an island in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: An aisle is the passage between pews or along the side of a church nave.

clue.text: Most orderly home — have food in it

indicators.note: the eating goes inside the home

parts.note: a nest is a home, especially a bird's
to eat is to have food

explanation.surface: The tidiest home is one where you eat inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Neatest is the superlative of neat, meaning tidiest or most orderly.
